name: Passport
definition: Booklet issued by a state to identify its holder for international travel.

name: National identity card
definition: Card issued by a state to prove the holder's identity and citizenship or residence.

name: Driving licence
definition: Document issued to permit its holder to drive.

name: Residence permit
definition: Document issued to a non-citizen to prove the right to reside.

name: Visa
definition: Label, stamp or sheet issued to permit entry to or stay in a country.

name: Birth certificate
definition: certificate recording a person's birth.

name: Marriage certificate
definition: Certificate recording a marriage, including the ketubah; one made as a picture is in Art.

name: Death certificate
definition: certificate recording a person's death.

name: Divorce papers
definition: decree or certificate recording the dissolution of a marriage.

name: Baptism certificate
definition: Certificate recording a baptism or christening; one made as a picture is in Art.

name: Vaccination certificate
definition: Paper record or card certifying vaccinations received.

name: Deed
definition: Document that conveys or proves title to property; the land itself is in Property & Structures.

name: Will
definition: document setting out how a person's estate is to be disposed of after death.

name: Promissory note
definition: signed written promise to pay a sum to a named party.

name: Share certificate
definition: Printed certificate of ownership of shares in a company.

name: Bond certificate
definition: printed certificate of a bond or debt owed by its issuer.

name: Cheque
definition: Printed order to a bank to pay a sum, kept as an object.

name: Traveller's cheque
definition: Pre-paid cheque in a fixed amount for travellers, kept as an object.

name: Postal order
definition: Money order issued by a post office, kept as an object.

name: Tax paper
definition: Paper tax return or assessment notice kept as a record.

name: Diploma
definition: document issued by a school or university to certify a degree or completed course.

name: Certificate of achievement
definition: document certifying an achievement, a qualification or membership of a body.

name: School report
definition: Report issued by a school on a pupil's progress.

name: Identity badge
definition: Badge or card bearing the holder's name or photograph, carried to show who the holder is.

name: Access badge
definition: badge or pass bearing the holder's name or photograph, carried to show what site or event the holder may enter.

name: Crew member certificate
definition: Identity document issued to airline crew in the standard international card formats.

name: Credit card
definition: card that draws on a line of credit from its issuer.

name: Debit card
definition: card that draws directly on the holder's bank account.

name: Charge card
definition: card whose balance must be paid in full each period.

name: ATM card
definition: card that gives access to a bank account at cash machines only.

name: Gift card
definition: Card holding a prepaid value redeemable for goods or services.

name: Gift certificate
definition: Paper voucher or gift token redeemable only with its issuer; circulating scrip is in Coins, Stamps, Medals & Trading Cards.

name: Telephone card
definition: Prepaid card for public telephones; optical, chip or magnetic.

name: Transit card
definition: Stored-value or pass card for public transport fares.

name: Membership card
definition: card issued to show the holder's membership of a club or body.

name: Loyalty card
definition: card issued by a retailer to collect discounts or points.

name: Key card
definition: Card that opens a lock and names no holder, such as a hotel key card.

name: SIM card
definition: Physical card that identifies a subscriber on a mobile network; an eSIM profile is part of a plan in Subscriptions, Memberships & Online Services.

name: Letter
definition: Written or typed message sent or kept on paper, signed letters included.

name: Diary or journal
definition: written personal diary or journal.

name: Written-in greeting card
definition: Greeting card that has been written in and kept; a blank one is in Office & Stationery.

name: Written-in notebook
definition: Notebook that has been written in and kept; a blank one is in Office & Stationery.

name: House plans
definition: drawn or printed plans of a dwelling kept as a record.

name: Posted envelope
definition: Envelope that passed through the post, other than a first-day cover or one issued by a postal administration.

name: Photograph
definition: Photograph printed on paper or card.

name: Slide
definition: Developed transparency mounted for projection or viewing.

name: Negative
definition: Developed photographic negative on film or plate.

name: Home film reel
definition: film shot by the owner or family on a reel (8 mm, Super 8, 16 mm).

name: Home videotape
definition: videotape recorded by the owner or family.

name: Photo album
definition: album holding photographic prints.

name: Scrapbook
definition: Album filled with kept papers of every kind; a blank scrapbook album is in Craft & Art Supplies.

name: Picture postcard
definition: Printed picture postcard, used or not; a real photo postcard is listed under Photograph.

name: Ticket stub
definition: used ticket kept after the event or journey.

name: Programme
definition: printed programme of a performance or event, kept.

name: Autograph
definition: Signature collected on a card or page.

name: Menu
definition: printed menu of a restaurant, banquet or voyage, kept.

name: Invitation
definition: printed invitation to an event, kept.

name: Advertising trade card
definition: Card issued by a business to advertise it; a card issued in a numbered series to be collected is in Coins, Stamps, Medals & Trading Cards.

name: Handbill
definition: Single printed advertising item kept after use, such as a handbill, flyer, leaflet or detached magazine or newspaper advertisement page; a poster is in Art, a catalogue or booklet in Media & Publications.

name: Business card
definition: printed card giving a person's or firm's name and contact details.

name: Receipt
definition: printed or written receipt or billhead, kept.

name: Label
definition: printed product or trade label, kept.

name: Broadside
definition: large single printed sheet issued as a public notice or announcement.

name: Bookplate
definition: Printed label pasted in a book to mark its owner.

name: Timetable
definition: Printed timetable of a transport service, kept.

name: Bookmark
definition: Printed or card bookmark, kept as ephemera.

name: Charge plate
definition: embossed metal or plastic plate issued by a store or company to identify a customer's charge account, the forerunner of the charge card

name: Visiting card
definition: small printed or engraved card bearing a person's name, left or exchanged on social calls (die-cut and hidden-name cards included); a card giving contact details for trade is the business card

name: Confirmation certificate
definition: Certificate recording a confirmation or first communion; one made as a picture is in Art.

name: Lottery ticket
definition: printed lottery ticket or scratch card kept after the draw

name: Citizenship certificate
definition: certificate issued by a state recording that the holder is, or has become, its citizen

name: Prepaid e-money card
definition: Reloadable stored-value card for small payments at many merchants, not drawing on a bank account.

name: Social security card
definition: card issued by a state showing the holder's social security or social insurance number
